in_sanskrit.name: ज्वाला
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is burning with passion, a lamp, a diyaa (earthen lamp)

in_marathi.name: Jwala
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Fire
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jwala हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jwala is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘jvala’, which means ‘a wick’, ‘a torch’, or ‘a flame’. In Hindu mythology, Jwala is the name of the Goddess of Fire, Agni. She is depicted as a fiery being with the power to consume all evil and purify the soul.

In Hindu mythology, Jwala is the name of the Goddess of Fire, Agni. She is depicted as a fiery being with the power to consume all evil and purify the soul.
